text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon and I visit a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Bow twice, clap twice, bow once, complete… I have completed my mission.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I reported that the number of instances I have detected my health as poor has increased recently.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: According to an online article I read, this is one method of improving poor health.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But I feel no different… There seems to be an error in the article's information.
Hey! Hold up, you two!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I recognize that voice as Inari's. Now halting movement in response to "hold up."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What have we got here? I came here to pray, but I couldn't help but overhear you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You guys don't know the first thing about shrine worship! You need more style!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You gotta put your heart and soul into ringing that bell and clapping your hands, and then pray right from your diaphragm!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You gotta show off the passion behind your wish if you want the gods to think it's worth granting!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. It seems the information was indeed mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Update of shrine visitation manual complete. I will now pray with "style."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, we end up trying to worship at the shrine again…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: First… Utilize heart and soul to ring the bell and clap hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang, clang! Clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I wish to purge my system of any faulty programs!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Stabilization of vital signs confirmed. The cleanup was successful, Master.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Woo! Now that was praying in style! The gods are gonna love that one.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So this is the power of "style." How intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether it's a result of her stylish shrine worship or not, Mihono Bourbon is back to full health!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang, clang! Craaaaash!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The bell has fallen down!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Are you girls hurt?! I've been thinking that it was time to install a new bell…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems our timing was bad, and now with the bell broken, we're unable to complete our worship. Left with no other options, we return to the academy.
